channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7-2026-11-06
item.description: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Tropical Smoothie Cafe: Tropic Fan Fest: Free 24 oz Smoothie with Any Bowl or Food Purchase, Every Day
item.guid: Tropical Smoothie Cafe-Tropic Fan Fest: Free 24 oz Smoothie wit-2026-11-06
item.description: November 2 through 8: Tropic Rewards members (free account) get a free 24 oz smoothie with any Tropic Bowl or food item, once a day, all week. Add the food and a smoothie to an app or tropicalsmoothiecafe.com order and tap Apply on the Tropic Fan Fest reward, or scan the app in the cafe; the credit covers the lowest-priced 24 oz smoothie. Excludes Toasted Snack Rolls, the Sunshine Smoothie, sides, sweets and kids' items; participating cafes. (Through November 8, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Qdoba: National Nacho Day: $7 Chicken Nachos with Code NACHODAY
item.guid: Qdoba-National Nacho Day: $7 Chicken Nachos wi-2026-11-06
item.description: Friday, November 6 only: an adult-size Create Your Own Nachos with Flame-Grilled Adobo Chicken or the new Chicken Tinga for $7. Use promo code NACHODAY at online or app checkout, or mention the promo in the restaurant; no account needed. One per customer, not valid on delivery or catering, cannot be combined with Rewards wallet items; participating U.S. and Puerto Rico locations. The code is printed on qdoba.com's homepage. (November 6, 2026 only)

item.title: Subway: Buy One Get One Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
item.guid: Subway-Buy One Get One Free Footlong for Sub Cl-2026-11-06
item.description: October 27 through November 8: every current or new Sub Club member (free account) gets a free Footlong of equal or lesser price with any Footlong bought in the Subway app or on subway.com. The offer sits in the app wallet automatically; one per order, add-ons extra, excludes Fresh Fit, 5 Meat Italian and Big Hot Pastrami. Choose turkey or veggie for a healthier pick. Stated in Subway's own October 21 newsroom release. (Through November 8, 2026)

item.title: Safeway: $5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5
item.guid: Safeway-$5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5-2026-11-06
item.description: Every Friday, Safeway's $5 Friday lineup includes fresh sushi rolls from the in-store counter for $5 (regularly $8 to $10), alongside other prepared-food deals like an 8-piece chicken bag. Check the weekly ad for your division; a free Safeway for U account may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Harris Teeter: $6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon Rolls
item.guid: Harris Teeter-$6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, -2026-11-06
item.description: Every Friday, Harris Teeter's Zenshi sushi counters sell four rolls for $6 each: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon (regularly about $9.49 to $10.49). In store, while supplies last; the free VIC card may be needed for the promo price. Seen in store October 2, 2026. (Southeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Yoshinoya: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
item.guid: Yoshinoya-$5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code -2026-11-06
item.description: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off). (California only only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: 2 for $12 Culinary Classics Entrees for Noodles Rewards Members
item.guid: Noodles & Company-2 for $12 Culinary Classics Entrees for -2026-11-06
item.description: Friday, November 6 through Tuesday, November 10: two regular-size Culinary Classics entrees (Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Baked Mac, Gochujang Carbonara Ramen and the rest of the line) for $12 together, for Noodles Rewards members (free account). Order signed in on noodles.com or in the app and apply the reward on the cart screen; one redemption per member during the promotion. Not valid on third-party delivery, call-in or catering orders; participating locations. Stated on Noodles' own offers terms page. (November 6 to 10, 2026)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: National Nacho Day: $5.99 Nachos Entree
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-National Nacho Day: $5.99 Nachos Entree-2026-11-06
item.description: Friday, November 6: a $5.99 Nachos entree in the restaurant for anyone who mentions the offer at checkout, no account needed. Moe Rewards members (free account) also get $5.99 Nachos entrees online or in the app from November 6 through Sunday, November 8 by applying the reward at checkout. Excludes add-ons, extras and premium proteins; single use; participating locations; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Moe's own offers page. (35 states (Southeast, Northeast & Midwest) only) (November 6 to 8, 2026)

item.title: Sarku Japan: $0 Delivery Fee on Orders of $10+ (Sarku Rewards)
item.guid: Sarku Japan-$0 Delivery Fee on Orders of $10+ (Sarku-2026-11-06
item.description: Sarku Rewards members (free to join) get $0 delivery on orders of $10 or more when ordering through the Sarku app or website through November 8. (Through November 8, 2026)

item.title: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
item.guid: Mezeh Mediterranean Grill-Free Delivery on Every Order Through the-2026-11-06
item.description: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage. (VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX only) (Through December 31, 2026)

item.title: Hy-Vee: Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One 50% Off
item.guid: Hy-Vee-Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One-2026-11-06
item.description: Every Friday at participating Hy-Vee stores, buy one regular Nori Sushi roll and get a second at half price. Store-run promotion: participation varies, no card or app needed. (Midwest only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-11-06
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-11-06
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Flame Broiler: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
item.guid: Flame Broiler-Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicke-2026-11-06
item.description: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage. (CA & Southwest only) (Limited time)

item.title: Nando's PERi-PERi: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
item.guid: Nando's PERi-PERi-$1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-P-2026-11-06
item.description: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant. (DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Waba Grill: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
item.guid: Waba Grill-Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini-2026-11-06
item.description: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage. (CA, AZ, NV & TX only) (Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends)

item.title: Smoothie King: Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for the Price of a 20 oz
item.guid: Smoothie King-Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for t-2026-11-06
item.description: Every Friday, Healthy Rewards members (free account required) get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz when they order in the Smoothie King app, at participating locations. Rewards cannot be redeemed on these orders. (Fridays only)

item.title: Hy-Vee: 15% off Meals To Go orders of $25 or more
item.guid: Hy-Vee-15% off Meals To Go orders of $25 or mor-2026-11-06
item.description: Hy-Vee Meals To Go prepared meal orders of $25+ get 15% off, announced by email on 2026-11-05; free Hy-Vee PERKS account may be required for savings tracking. (Midwest only) (Limited time)
